title: Chair — one Math Engine, seat, back, legs and arms
description:
A parametric CHAIR on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A NODE, A SEGMENT OR A SPACE. On a segment or a space the chair faces along the host's direction; Rotation turns it about its host and Flip side swaps which way it looks.

WHAT IT BUILDS. Four legs — the two back legs continue upward as the back uprights, which is what a real chair does and what keeps the back from floating — a seat, a back that is either a solid panel or N slats, and an optional pair of arms with their front supports.

THE SLAT DIVISION IS ONE BROADCAST. For N slats the clear span is cut into 2N+1 equal parts and the slats take the ODD ones, so slat and gap are equal and the run is symmetric at every count with no special case at N = 1. `(2 * arange(N) + 1) * w` is every slat's near edge at once.

PANEL OR SLATS is a ternary between two matrices — `_isPanel ? _BP : _SL` — not a branch in the flow. Both forms are the same 11-column quad table, so the kernel downstream never learns which one it got.

WHY QUADS AND NOT BOXES. Every part is a quad swept z0 → z1, so a splayed leg or a tapered back would need no new code.

THE PLAN IS DERIVED from the same quads with z dropped; each part is its own 2D row because a grouped outline list is read EVEN-ODD and the seat sits over the legs.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS: 0.46 × 0.46 m, 1.35 m to the top of the back, seat at 0.45 m, three 0.053 m slats.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. Legs are vertical and the back is upright — no rake, no splay, no curved back. Nothing is mitred: parts interpenetrate at the joints.

params.name: Chair maths
params.expr:
_natL = depth
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_Wd = width * _s
_Dp = depth * _s
_seatH = seatHeight * _s
_seatT = seatThk * _s
_backH = backHeight * _s
_backT = backThk * _s
_lg = legSize * _s
_armH = armHeight * _s
_armT = armThk * _s
_u0 = 0 - _Dp / 2
_u1 = _Dp / 2
_v0 = 0 - _Wd / 2
_v1 = _Wd / 2
_seatBot = _seatH - _seatT
_bodyL = _Dp
_bodyW = _Wd
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
# Legs — the two back legs run on up as the back uprights
_L1 = hcat(_u0, _v0, _u0 + _lg, _v0, _u0 + _lg, _v0 + _lg, _u0, _v0 + _lg, 0, _seatH + _backH, 5)
_L2 = hcat(_u0, _v1 - _lg, _u0 + _lg, _v1 - _lg, _u0 + _lg, _v1, _u0, _v1, 0, _seatH + _backH, 5)
_L3 = hcat(_u1 - _lg, _v0, _u1, _v0, _u1, _v0 + _lg, _u1 - _lg, _v0 + _lg, 0, _seatBot, 5)
_L4 = hcat(_u1 - _lg, _v1 - _lg, _u1, _v1 - _lg, _u1, _v1, _u1 - _lg, _v1, 0, _seatBot, 5)
# Seat
_SEAT = hcat(_u0, _v0, _u1, _v0, _u1, _v1, _u0, _v1, _seatBot, _seatH, 1)
# Back — a solid panel, or slats spread across the width in one broadcast
_isPanel = backStyle == 'Panel'
_bz0 = _seatH + 0.06 * _s
_bz1 = _seatH + _backH
_BP = hcat(_u0, _v0 + _lg, _u0 + _backT, _v0 + _lg, _u0 + _backT, _v1 - _lg, _u0, _v1 - _lg, _bz0, _bz1, 3)
_nsl = max(1, round(slats))
_sspan = max(0.02 * _s, _Wd - 2 * _lg)
_sw = _sspan / (2 * _nsl + 1)
_sa = _v0 + _lg + (2 * arange(_nsl) + 1) * _sw
_SL = hcat(fill(_nsl,1,_u0), _sa, fill(_nsl,1,_u0 + _backT), _sa, fill(_nsl,1,_u0 + _backT), _sa + _sw, fill(_nsl,1,_u0), _sa + _sw, fill(_nsl,1,_bz0), fill(_nsl,1,_bz1), fill(_nsl,1,3))
_BACK = _isPanel ? _BP : _SL
# Arms
_hasArm = arms > 0
_A1r = hcat(_u0 + _lg, _v0, _u1 - 0.06 * _s, _v0, _u1 - 0.06 * _s, _v0 + _armT, _u0 + _lg, _v0 + _armT, _armH - _armT, _armH, 4)
_A2r = hcat(_u0 + _lg, _v1 - _armT, _u1 - 0.06 * _s, _v1 - _armT, _u1 - 0.06 * _s, _v1, _u0 + _lg, _v1, _armH - _armT, _armH, 4)
_A3r = hcat(_u1 - 0.06 * _s - _armT, _v0, _u1 - 0.06 * _s, _v0, _u1 - 0.06 * _s, _v0 + _armT, _u1 - 0.06 * _s - _armT, _v0 + _armT, _seatH, _armH, 4)
_A4r = hcat(_u1 - 0.06 * _s - _armT, _v1 - _armT, _u1 - 0.06 * _s, _v1 - _armT, _u1 - 0.06 * _s, _v1, _u1 - 0.06 * _s - _armT, _v1, _seatH, _armH, 4)
_ARM = _hasArm ? vcat(_A1r, _A2r, _A3r, _A4r) : zeros(0, 11)
Q = vcat(_L1, _L2, _L3, _L4, _SEAT, _BACK, _ARM)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Seat3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Back3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 3)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Arms3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 4)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Frame3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 5)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
SeatPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
BackPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 3)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
ArmsPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 4)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
FramePlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 5)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Metrics
overallWidth = _Wd
overallDepth = _Dp
overallHeight = _seatH + _backH
seatTop = _seatH
slatWidth = _isPanel ? (_Wd - 2 * _lg) : _sw
footprint = _Dp * _Wd
